positive_evidence: Labels are used for admin step-up password
Icon buttons commonly have title attributes or visible context
Minimum touch sizing appears in AppLayout/MobileNav

findings.evidence: Raw table markup has headers but no explicit scope/caption evidence
findings.impact: Table relationships may be less robust for assistive technology

findings.evidence: Loading and mutation feedback is primarily visual text/toast; live-region announcement was not evidenced
findings.impact: Screen-reader users may miss async state changes

findings.evidence: Icon-only More trigger has no explicit aria-label in inspected code; visible label is separate text
findings.impact: Accessible name behavior should be verified

findings.evidence: Complex tabs/dialog/action surface requires keyboard focus and focus-return verification; source review alone cannot prove it

not_claimed: No full WCAG compliance claim; runtime keyboard, contrast, and screen-reader testing was not performed.
